import csv,hashlib,io,json,math,re
from pathlib import Path
import pymupdf
root=Path.cwd().resolve(); directory=root/"benchmark_tools/results"
output=directory/"native_qfo_comparator_integration_20261009_v1"
manifest=json.loads((output/"manifest.json").read_text())
def identity(path):
    blob=Path(path).read_bytes()
    return dict(bytes=len(blob),sha256=hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest())
for ref in [*manifest["inputs"],*manifest["outputs"],manifest["manuscript"]]:
    assert identity(ref["path"]) == {k:ref[k] for k in ("bytes","sha256")}
result=json.loads((directory/"native_qfo_comparator_uncertainty_20261009_v1/report.json").read_text())
rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO((output/"endpoints.tsv").read_text()),delimiter="\t"))
cells=["p0_c0_r0","p0_c0_r1","p0_c1_r0","p0_c1_r1","p1_c0_r0","p1_c0_r1","p1_c1_r0","p1_c1_r1"]
comparators=["orthofinder_3_1_5_full","orthofinder_3_1_5_sequence_only"]
metrics=["F1","PPV","TPR"]
assert len(rows)==48 and sum(r["difference"]=="" for r in rows)==24
expected_order=[(c,ref,m) for c in cells for ref in comparators for m in metrics]
assert [(r["candidate"],r["reference"],r["metric"]) for r in rows]==expected_order
mapping={(c["candidate"],c["reference"]):c for c in result["comparisons"]}
for row in rows:
    comparison=mapping[(row["candidate"],row["reference"])]
    assert row["status"]==comparison["status"] and row["missing_reason"]==(comparison["missing_reason"] or "")
    numeric=("difference","nominal_low","nominal_high","adjusted_low","adjusted_high","family_wins","family_ties","family_losses")
    if comparison["metrics"] is None:
        assert all(row[k]=="" for k in numeric)
    else:
        item=comparison["metrics"][row["metric"]]
        expected=[item["difference"],*item["paired_percentile_ci"],*item["bonferroni_percentile_ci"],
                  *[item[k] for k in ("family_wins","family_ties","family_losses")]]
        assert all(float(row[k])==value for k,value in zip(numeric,expected))
methods=(output/"methods_section.md").read_text()
results=(output/"results_section.md").read_text()
revised=Path(manifest["manuscript"]["path"]).read_text()
parent=(directory/"native_qfo_terminal_failures_20261009_v1_manuscript.md").read_text()
assert revised.count(methods)==revised.count(results)==1
assert revised.replace(methods,"",1).replace(results,"",1)==parent
f1_lines=[line for line in results.splitlines() if line.startswith("| P")]
assert len(f1_lines)==8
for comparison in result["comparisons"]:
    if comparison["metrics"] is not None:
        v=comparison["metrics"]["F1"]
        label=comparison["candidate"].upper().replace("_","/")
        reference="Full OrthoFinder" if comparison["reference"]==comparators[0] else "Sequence-Only OrthoFinder"
        signs="/".join(str(v[k]) for k in ("family_wins","family_ties","family_losses"))
        expected=f"| {label} | {reference} | {v['difference']:+.6f} | [{v['bonferroni_percentile_ci'][0]:.6f}, {v['bonferroni_percentile_ci'][1]:.6f}] | {signs} |"
        assert expected in f1_lines
assert sum((v["bonferroni_percentile_ci"][0]>0 or v["bonferroni_percentile_ci"][1]<0)
           for c in result["comparisons"] if c["metrics"] is not None for v in c["metrics"].values())==8
pdf=pymupdf.open(output/"native_comparator_sensitivity.pdf")
assert len(pdf)==1
page=pdf[0]; w,h=page.rect.width,page.rect.height
assert abs(w-1152)<1e-6 and abs(h-792)<1e-6
text=page.get_text()
for phrase in ("48-endpoint adjusted CI","Not supplied","Inference SIGSEGV","Assessment OOM",
               "vs full OrthoFinder","vs sequence-only checkpoint","percentage points"):
    assert phrase in text
bounds=[]
for block in page.get_text("dict")["blocks"]:
    for line in block.get("lines",[]):
        for span in line["spans"]:
            x0,y0,x1,y1=span["bbox"]
            assert 0<=x0<=x1<=w and 0<=y0<=y1<=h
            bounds.append(span["bbox"])
colors=[(22/255,125/255,141/255),(189/255,65/255,72/255),(154/255,113/255,12/255)]
drawings=page.get_drawings()
colored=[]
for drawing in drawings:
    color=drawing.get("color")
    if color is not None and any(max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(color,c))<1e-5 for c in colors):
        colored.append(drawing)
lines=[d for d in colored if len(d["items"])==1 and d["items"][0][0]=="l"]
markers=[d for d in colored if any(item[0]=="c" for item in d["items"])]
assert len(lines)==48 and len(markers)==24,(len(lines),len(markers))
axisw=w*(.985-.115)/(3+2*.16)
axish=h*(.885-.09)/(2+.30)
used=set(); used_markers=set()
for row in rows:
    if row["difference"]=="":
        continue
    i=comparators.index(row["reference"]); j=metrics.index(row["metric"]); y=cells.index(row["candidate"])
    left=w*.115+j*axisw*1.16
    top=h*(1-.885)+i*axish*1.30
    ypos=top+axish*(y+.6)/8.2
    xpos=lambda value:left+axisw*(100*value+60)/120
    for key,width in (("adjusted",1.2),("nominal",4)):
        lo,hi=xpos(float(row[key+"_low"])),xpos(float(row[key+"_high"]))
        matches=[]
        for k,drawing in enumerate(lines):
            item=drawing["items"][0]; a,b=item[1],item[2]
            if (max(abs(a.x-lo),abs(b.x-hi),abs(a.y-ypos),abs(b.y-ypos))<.002
                    and abs(drawing["width"]-width)<1e-5
                    and max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(drawing["color"],colors[j]))<1e-5):
                matches.append(k)
        assert len(matches)==1 and matches[0] not in used,(row,key,matches)
        used.add(matches[0])
    x=xpos(float(row["difference"]))
    matches=[]
    for k,drawing in enumerate(markers):
        rect=drawing["rect"]
        if (max(abs((rect.x0+rect.x1)/2-x),abs((rect.y0+rect.y1)/2-ypos))<.002
                and max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(drawing["color"],colors[j]))<1e-5):
            matches.append(k)
    assert len(matches)==1 and matches[0] not in used_markers,(row,matches)
    used_markers.add(matches[0])
assert len(used)==48 and len(used_markers)==24
preview=output/"native_comparator_sensitivity_pdf_preview.png"
assert not preview.exists()
page.get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(1.5,1.5),alpha=False).save(preview)
pdf.close()
print(json.dumps(dict(status="independent_native_comparator_integration_readback_passed",
    manifest=identity(output/"manifest.json"),tsv_rows=48,estimated_endpoints=24,missing_endpoints=24,
    manuscript_f1_rows=8,parent_body_restored_exactly=True,adjusted_intervals_excluding_zero=8,
    figure_pdf_pages=1,pdf_interval_segments_checked=48,pdf_point_markers_checked=24,
    pdf_text_spans_in_bounds=len(bounds),pdf_preview=dict(path=str(preview),**identity(preview)),
    production_helpers_imported=False,publication_ready=False),allow_nan=False))
